text: {"assertions":["An off-by-one cent bug was discovered in billing/invoice_totals.py's invoice totals calculator that affected invoice reconciliation.","The bug only manifested when processing payloads larger than approximately 2 megabytes.","The bug appeared as a one cent gap in the reconciliation report when totaling invoices with three prorated lines.","The root cause was the serialiser dropping unknown fields from the invoice data.","The fix involved switching to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields instead of silently dropping them.","The fix was submitted as PR #1961 on the fix/off-by-one-cent-1 branch.","After implementing the fix, the previously flaky test improved from 89 failures per 100 runs to zero failures.","The test coverage for this component is in tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py using Python."]}
